title: Labelbox Raises $100M+ Series E at $1.25B Valuation to Advance RL and AI Agents
key_facts: Labelbox said on 14 Oct that it raised more than $100 million in a Series E at a $1.25 billion pre-money valuation, with equity plus a credit facility.
Infinitum Partners led; Wipro Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, B Capital and others joined.
Labelbox says it became profitable in 2026 and grew more than fivefold year on year.
It reports more than 400 customers, including over 90% of leading US AI labs.
Its products are Horizon (practice worlds for training AI models) and Recursion Managed Agents.
Chief executive Manu Sharma wrote in a company post that access to computing power will be central to its next chapter.
